notes: Read all 261 line-numbered source lines before editing; every line was considered. This is a non-visual data hook (no JSX/DOM/Recharts/Leaflet/browser API), so the port is a faithful 1:1 logic translation — state names, API paths, SI unit handling, and computed-stat semantics are preserved exactly. Only cross-module deps with no native runtime are inlined as native-safe shims.

L1 `import { useMemo } from 'react'` -> `import {useCallback, useMemo} from 'react'`. useCallback is added solely to satisfy the native lint config (see toDistanceDisplay/toSpeedDisplay note); useMemo usage is unchanged.

L2 `import { useDrive } from '@/api/hooks/useDriving'` -> native `useDrive` from ../../../../api/hooks/useDriving (returns DriveDetail with camelCase fields vehicleId/telemetry/positions/startLat/startLon/maxSpeedMps/avgSpeedMps/avgPowerW/durationS/energyUsedWh/regenEnergyWh/distanceM/startBatteryPct/endBatteryPct — all fields this hook reads exist verbatim).
L3 `import { useVehicle } from '@/api/hooks/useVehicles'` -> native `useVehicle(id: string)` from ../../../../api/hooks/useVehicles.

L4 `import { useUnits } from '@/hooks/useUnits'` -> inline native-safe `useUnits()` deriving {distance, speed, temperature, pressure} from the web-parity useSettings() query exactly as the web hook does: unit_of_length 'mi' -> distance 'mi'/speed 'mph' else 'km'/'km/h'; unit_of_temp 'F' -> temperature '\u00b0F' else '\u00b0C'; unit_of_pressure 'psi' -> pressure 'psi' else 'bar'. useMemo-stable over the primitive prefs (the established MoreDetailsPanel native convention, extended here with `pressure` because this hook needs it).

L5 `import { useDateFormat } from '@/hooks/useDateFormat'` -> the only member used is formatTime; ported as a module-level `formatTime` (web default-locale branch, the established native DriveTimeline convention): '\u2014' for nullish / invalid Date, else toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) in the device locale/timezone (no native tz library is ported yet — documented native reduction).

L6-11 `import { convertDistanceFromSI, convertSpeedFromSI, convertTempFromSI, convertPressureFromSI } from '@/lib/unitConversion'` -> ported byte-for-byte as pure SI->display converters with NIST factors (METERS_PER_MILE 1609.344, METERS_PER_KM 1000, METERS_PER_FOOT 0.3048, KPA_PER_PSI 6.894757, KPA_PER_BAR 100, SECONDS_PER_HOUR 3600). Param unions DistanceUnitPref('km'|'mi'|'ft'), SpeedUnitPref('km/h'|'mph'), TemperatureUnitPref('\u00b0C'|'\u00b0F'), PressureUnitPref('kPa'|'psi'|'bar') keep the exhaustive switches return-complete under strict mode.

L12 `import { fmtNumber } from '@/lib/numberFormat'` -> ported `safeNumber` (typeof number & Number.isFinite, else 0) + `fmtNumber(v, decimals=2)` via toLocaleString('en-US', {min=max fraction digits}) with toFixed fallback. The web module-level globals (_globalPrecision/_globalLocale mutated by useSettings) are approximated by the en-US/precision-2 default — the established native numberFormat convention (MoreDetailsPanel); histogram labels call fmtNumber(min)/fmtNumber(max).

L13 `import type { LatLngExpression } from '@/components/maps'` -> native-safe local `type LatLngExpression = [number, number] | {lat; lng; alt?}` (Leaflet is DOM-only and forbidden in native). The hook only ever produces [lat, lng] tuples; keeping a tuple member in the union preserves the web's contextual-tuple inference for `trail`/`speedSegments.positions`.

L14 `import type { ChartDataPoint, DriveStats, RoutePoint, SpeedSegment, SpeedHistogramBucket } from './types'` -> the 5 interfaces inlined + re-exported verbatim (field names + null types match ./types.ts exactly; energyWh/regenWh stay SI Wh, consumptionWhKm stays Wh/km — no unit-suffix drift). Self-contained per the file-by-file native convention.

L15 `import { SPEED_SEGMENT_LOW_MPS, SPEED_SEGMENT_MED_MPS, SPEED_SEGMENT_HIGH_MPS } from './constants'` -> inlined + re-exported verbatim (30/60/100 mph * 0.44704 m/s); the route colour bands compare raw m/s SI against these.

L17-19 `export function useDriveDetailData(id)`, `const { data: drive, isLoading, error } = useDrive(id)`, `const { data: vehicle } = useVehicle(String(drive?.vehicleId ?? ''))` -> ported identically (named export, same destructured state names, same vehicleId->string coercion + API path via the native hooks).

L20-24 unitPrefs comment + `const { unitPrefs } = useUnits()` + `toDistanceDisplay` -> ported. The web declares toDistanceDisplay/toSpeedDisplay (L24/L26) as plain arrow functions and relies on its lint config treating react-hooks/exhaustive-deps as a WARNING; the native config treats it as an ERROR, so both are wrapped in useCallback over the same primitive prefs ([unitPrefs.distance] / [unitPrefs.speed]). The computed `stats` OUTPUT is identical — only the internal, unobservable recompute frequency changes — so behavior/unit-handling/values are fully preserved. A code comment documents this.
L26-31 toSpeedDisplay + the SI-converter rationale comment -> ported (toSpeedDisplay wrapped in useCallback as above; comment preserved verbatim).

L34-47 routeSource useMemo<RoutePoint[]> -> ported 1:1: empty when !drive; prefers telemetry (filter lat/lng non-null AND not both-zero, map to {lat: tp.latitude!, lng: tp.longitude!, speed: tp.speed ?? 0}); else positions (filter not-both-zero, map to {lat, lng, speed: p.speed ?? 0}). Deps [drive].

L49-53 trail / startPos / endPos / centerPos -> ported verbatim: `trail: LatLngExpression[] = useMemo(() => routeSource.map(p => [p.lat, p.lng]), [routeSource])` (annotation kept so contextual tuple inference flows); startPos = trail[0] as [number,number]|undefined; endPos = trail.length>1 ? last as [number,number] : undefined; centerPos = startPos ?? (drive?.startLat && drive?.startLon ? [startLat, startLon] : [47.6, -122.3]).

L55-70 speedSegments useMemo<SpeedSegment[]> -> ported 1:1: for i=1..n, colour default #10b981, >=HIGH_MPS #ef4444, >=MED_MPS #f59e0b, >=LOW_MPS #00f0ff; push {positions: [[prev.lat,prev.lng],[curr.lat,curr.lng]], color}. Deps [routeSource]. The SI m/s band comment preserved.

L72-128 chartData useMemo<ChartDataPoint[]> -> ported 1:1. Telemetry branch (tele.length>0): time=formatTime(createdAt ?? created_at ?? timestamp); speed=convertSpeedFromSI(speed ?? 0); battery/elevation/power with ?? 0; outside/inside/driver/passengerTemp via convertTempFromSI when non-null else null; ideal/rated/est/odometer via convertDistanceFromSI when non-null else null; soc/usableSoc passthrough; tireFl/Fr/Rl/Rr via convertPressureFromSI(value/1000) when non-null else null; climateOn=isClimateOn ?? null; fanStatus ?? null. Position fallback branch keeps the web `(p: any)` cast + the exact eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any comment to read snake_case fallbacks (battery_level/outside_temp/inside_temp/ideal_range/rated_range); driverTemp/passengerTemp/estRange/soc/usableSoc/tire* forced to `null as number|null`; the speed/_mph ADR-004 comment preserved. Deps [drive, unitPrefs.speed, unitPrefs.temperature, unitPrefs.distance, unitPrefs.pressure] — formatTime is now module-level/stable so it is no longer a dep (web listed it because it came from a hook); output is identical.

L130-217 stats useMemo<DriveStats|null> -> ported 1:1: null when !drive; maxSpd/avgSpd via toSpeedDisplay when non-null else 0; minSpd = min of non-zero chart speeds else 0; powerValues = non-zero powers; powerMax = max(powerValues) else avgPowerW/1000; powerMin = min(powerValues) else 0; avgPower = avgPowerW/1000 else mean of chart power; durationH = durationS/3600; energyWh = energyUsedWh else |avgPower|*durationH*1000; regenWh = regenEnergyWh else sum(|negative power|)*(durationH/n)*1000; consumptionWhKm = energyWh/(distanceM/1000) when distanceM>0 else 0; elevGain/elevLoss accumulate positive/negative elevation deltas; temp arrays + avgOutside/avgInside + hasAnyTemp; climateOn/off counts -> climateStatus 'On'/'Mostly Off'/'Off'/null; fanValues type-guarded -> avgFanSpeed/maxFanSpeed; first/lastWithRange -> startRange/endRange (idealRange ?? ratedRange); first/lastOdometer scan (>0) -> odometerStart/odometerEnd (?? 0); hasTirePressure via some(); efficiencyPctPer100 = (startBatteryPct-endBatteryPct)/toDistanceDisplay(distanceM)*10 when distanceM>0 && both pct non-null else null. Returns the same 28-field object. Deps [drive, chartData, toSpeedDisplay, toDistanceDisplay] (now stable via useCallback).

L219-245 speedHistData useMemo<SpeedHistogramBucket[]> -> ported 1:1: [] when chartData empty; 7 bucket defs (0-20,20-40,40-60,60-80,80-100,100-120,120-9999); bucket range label = `${fmtNumber(min)}+` for the 9999 sentinel else `${fmtNumber(min)}\u2013${fmtNumber(max)}` (en-dash preserved); forEach increments matching bucket; return only non-empty buckets mapped to {range, pct: round(count/total*100)}. Deps [chartData]. The display-unit-bucket comment preserved.
L247-261 return object -> ported verbatim: drive: drive ?? null, vehicle: vehicle ?? null, isLoading, error, chartData, stats, trail, startPos, endPos, centerPos, speedSegments, speedHistData.

Explicit native reductions (all native-safe, behavior/state/API-path/SI-unit/i18n preserving): (1) useUnits -> inline useSettings-derived hook surfacing distance/speed/temperature/pressure; (2) useDateFormat.formatTime -> module-level default-locale formatTime (no native tz lib yet); (3) unitConversion converters + numberFormat fmtNumber -> verbatim local ports (en-US/precision-2 default for the web globals); (4) Leaflet LatLngExpression type -> native-safe tuple|literal union; (5) ./types + ./constants -> inlined + re-exported (self-contained per file-by-file convention); (6) toDistanceDisplay/toSpeedDisplay wrapped in useCallback to satisfy the native error-level react-hooks/exhaustive-deps rule (output identical). This hook has no JSX, so no co-located RN render test is added (consistent with sibling driving/charging/analytics utility ports); the existing Jest suite remains green.
